description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy -Order to Impose Special Commodity Levy on Red Onions, Dates, Grapes etc, for a 6 month period from 21.05.2017
categorisation: This gazette content imposes a Special Commodity Levy on various goods through an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It establishes regulatory requirements and compliance measures for specific commodities, falling under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does so only to establish the authority making the order and does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or constitute a personnel appointment.
